extensionDescription.message: Shows synced lyrics in the Singline app for what you play on YouTube, YouTube Music and other web players, even in a background tab.

popupNotPairedHint.message: Pair once with the code from Singline.

popupUnreachableHint.message: Open Singline on this computer. The lyrics appear as soon as it runs.

popupProblem.message: Singline did not answer as expected

popupProblemHint.message: Restart Singline if this does not go away.

popupPairHint.message: Open the Singline settings, find “Browser extension” and enter the code shown there.

popupNothing.message: Play something on YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, Apple Music or Amazon Music.

errorInvalidCode.message: Enter the six digits Singline shows.

errorWrongCode.message: That code did not match. Check the code in Singline and try again.

errorPairingClosed.message: Open the Singline settings so the code is shown, then try again.

errorNotRunning.message: Singline is not running on this computer.

errorFailed.message: Pairing did not work. Try again.
